$comment: platform/github/oidc-trust.json. The GitHub Actions contexts whose OIDC token the estate's identity domain may exchange for the estate-ci OCI session (the session that reads the GitHub App key and the vault). One list, read by bin/idp-oidc-trust (reconciles the IdentityPropagationTrust `github-actions-estate`), by bin/idp-github-app token (refuses to mint outside it), and by tests/test_oidc_trust_admits_only_reviewed_contexts.py (every workflow that exchanges a token is covered; no lane, queue or pull-request ref ever is). Founder 2026-11-06: close the stale-lane privileged-run gap at its root; generic pull_request is excluded because GitHub executes the PR branch's workflow definition.

contexts.why: every schedule, workflow_dispatch, workflow_run, check_run, issue_comment and repository_dispatch run executes the default branch's reviewed definition
image-update-pr.yml runs on the image controller's push; the controller, not an agent, writes this branch
